title: The Waist row target "Target <89" has no unit while the page shows "<89 cm"
evidence: Done 2026-11-14: a row with no value shows its target with its unit, health-core rowTarget's alone ("Target <89 cm", "Optimal <1.4 mmol/L", "Target <120/80 mmHg"), chosen by the web's rows (MyDataRows.tsx) and the iPhone engine's (my-data.ts); a row with a value keeps the unitless bare, its unit under the value, so a limit-only waist shows "cm" once (PR 1716, replacing PR 1710). Left: H103. Was: seen in the PR 1508 shots: the My health Waist row reads "Target <89" with no unit, while its value page reads "<89 cm". The other half is closed, not a bug: the vitals grid's amber Weight trend dash is the latest value's real grade tick (bt-status-warn, BMI 25.2 in the shot), drawn when there are fewer than two points for a sparkline; greying it would hide a real grade (found in PR 1571). (H83)
